>wrote: : Can you have more than 4 uncontrolled vamps on the table?
> If you draw them from your crypt, yes.

Or steal them from other players, or...

>: It says votes happen when political cards come out or when a
>: diablerie happened. Do the political cards have actions on them, or
>: do you just say "I want this vampire to leave play, vote on it"?

Political action cards are just like normal action cards except that
you can burn them for votes during a vote process. (I guess the fact
that they all start votes also makes them an exception.) Note that
you can also take political actions if cards in play, such as Anarch
Revolt, allow it, and this advantage of such actions does not require
playing a political action card from the hand. The bloodhunt vote is
not an action; any player simply calls one if they wish, if diablerie
is committed.
